name: Debugger Exit — route debugger verdict to the right handler
description: Wraps the debugger card as one core node. Conditional edges route the exit verdict: fixed→re-verify, escalated-design→PO, blocked-hitl→PO. Re-verify FAIL loops back to re-debug (max 10, configurable via debugger-exit.config.json). Cap exceeded → escalate to PO.

nodes.body_template: noop — extract verdict from trigger metadata
